description: This file defines a REST API endpoint class for managing employee subordinates within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management System. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting subordinate relationships, with associated validation rules and OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for managing employee subordinate relationships, implementing CRUD operations with validation and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinates for a specific employee, with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Adds a new subordinate to an employee.

methods.name: setSubordinateParams
methods.description: Sets subordinate details from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving subordinate list.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified subordinate relationships for an employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific subordinate relationship.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee and subordinate IDs from URL parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single subordinate.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the reporting method for a subordinate.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating subordinate data.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for employee number parameter.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for reporting method ID parameter.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdsRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for list of subordinate IDs.
